datasets.name: machine
queryLines:
SELECT d.*, v.verdict_chip, v.gm_rank, v.adjusted_rank, v.last_zone, v.last_bank_name
            FROM workspace.royale.gold_machine_day d JOIN workspace.royale.gold_machine_verdict v USING (machine_id)

datasets.name: comparison
queryLines:
SELECT machine_id, theo_usd, house_win_usd, verdict_chip, gm_rank, adjusted_rank
            FROM workspace.royale.gold_machine_verdict WHERE gm_rank<=10 OR adjusted_rank<=10

datasets.name: traffic
queryLines:
SELECT *, CASE zone_id
            WHEN 'Z-B40' THEN 'Back Forty' WHEN 'Z-BAR' THEN 'Bar Row' WHEN 'Z-ENT' THEN 'Main Entrance'
            WHEN 'Z-GAR' THEN 'Garage Entrance' WHEN 'Z-HL' THEN 'High-Limit Room'
            WHEN 'Z-HTL' THEN 'Hotel Corridor' WHEN 'Z-PIT' THEN 'Center Pit' END AS zone_name
            FROM workspace.royale.gold_zone_gaming_hour

datasets.name: walkway
queryLines:
SELECT *, CASE phase WHEN 'pre' THEN '1 Before' WHEN 'closure' THEN '2 Closed'
            ELSE '3 After' END AS period FROM workspace.royale.gold_walkway_did

datasets.name: demand
queryLines:
SELECT d.*, f.forecast_usd, f.split FROM workspace.royale.gold_demand_context_day d
            JOIN workspace.royale.gold_forecast_day f USING (gaming_date)

datasets.name: ladder
queryLines:
SELECT player_rank,cumulative_player_share,cumulative_theo_share,cumulative_coin_in_share
            FROM workspace.royale.gold_lorenz WHERE PMOD(player_rank,400)=0 OR player_rank IN (1,1138,11389,113890)

datasets.name: segments
queryLines:
SELECT *, TO_DATE(CONCAT(period_month,'-01')) AS gaming_date
            FROM workspace.royale.gold_player_decile_month

datasets.name: hist
queryLines:
SELECT bin_id, CASE bin_id WHEN 0 THEN '0 No tracked gaming' WHEN 1 THEN '1 Below −$1,000'
            WHEN 2 THEN '2 −$1,000 to −$100' WHEN 3 THEN '3 Loss under $100' WHEN 4 THEN '4 Exactly zero'
            WHEN 5 THEN '5 Win up to $100' WHEN 6 THEN '6 $100 to $1,000' ELSE '7 Above $1,000' END AS band,
            observations, player_net_usd FROM workspace.royale.gold_player_net_histogram WHERE period='Jan–Jun'

datasets.name: comps
queryLines: SELECT *, valuation_date AS gaming_date FROM workspace.royale.gold_comp_week

datasets.name: tech_sensitivity
queryLines: SELECT * FROM workspace.royale.gold_action_plan WHERE horizon_days=30 AND action_type_id IN ('A-TECH-SHIFT','A-PREVENTIVE')

lines:
## Replace none of the GM’s bottom ten in July, inspect M-1158, defer the underpowered comp pilot, and keep $98,800 in reserve.

**THE GILDED ACE · EYE IN THE SKY** · Fictional casino · Jan–Jun 2025 evidence

**Comp monitoring:** review comp pricing and tracked play if cost exceeds 1.50% of tracked theo for two consecutive complete gaming weeks.

**Pilot power:** the 60-day MDE is larger in dollars ($7.61 vs $4.15) but smaller as a share (5.77% vs 6.44%) because the baseline contribution accumulates over more days.
